module nn_axi_wrapper #(
    parameter BASE_ADDR = 32'h0001_4000
)(
    input wire         clk,
    input wire         rst_n,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Native SoC memory-mapped slave interface
    //
    // IMPORTANT:
    // bus_addr is the LOCAL NN address generated by soc_mem_interconnect.
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    input  wire         bus_req,
    input  wire         bus_write,
    input  wire [31:0]  bus_addr,
    input  wire [31:0]  bus_wdata,
    input  wire [3:0]   bus_strb,

    output reg          bus_ready,
    output reg  [31:0]  bus_rdata,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Accelerator command/payload interface
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    output reg          axis_start,

    output reg [63:0]   weight0,
    output reg [63:0]   weight1,
    output reg [63:0]   weight2,
    output reg [63:0]   weight3,
    output reg [63:0]   weight4,

    output reg [63:0]   input0,
    output reg [63:0]   input1,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Accelerator status
    //
    // These are generated by nn_axis_master/tpu_axis_top.
    // They are NOT ports of axis_nn.
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    input wire          axis_busy,
    input wire          axis_done,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Accelerator result registers
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    input wire [63:0]   result0,
    input wire [63:0]   result1
);


-------------------------------------------------------------

module nn_axis_master (

    input wire         clk,
    input wire         rst_n,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Command from MMIO wrapper
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    input wire         axis_start,

    input wire [63:0]  weight0,
    input wire [63:0]  weight1,
    input wire [63:0]  weight2,
    input wire [63:0]  weight3,
    input wire [63:0]  weight4,

    input wire [63:0]  input0,
    input wire [63:0]  input1,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AXI4-Stream output toward axis_nn
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
    input  wire        m_axis_tready,
    output reg [63:0]  m_axis_tdata,
    output reg         m_axis_tlast,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Result AXI4-Stream input from axis_nn
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    input wire         s_axis_tvalid,
    output reg         s_axis_tready,
    input wire [63:0]  s_axis_tdata,
    input wire         s_axis_tlast,

    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Accelerator status
    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    output reg         axis_busy,
    output reg         axis_done

-----------------------------------------------
module axis_nn
    (
        input wire         aclk,
        input wire         aresetn,
        // *** AXIS slave port ***
        output wire        s_axis_tready,
        input wire [63:0]  s_axis_tdata,
        input wire         s_axis_tvalid,
        input wire         s_axis_tlast,
        // *** AXIS master port ***
        input wire         m_axis_tready,
        output wire [63:0] m_axis_tdata,
        output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
        output wire        m_axis_tlast
    );

    tpu ports
